children: RPM International Chief Executive Officer Frank Sullivan plans to retire, capping off nearly 25 years at the helm of the building-products supplier.
Sullivan intends to retire within the next 12 to 18 months, the company said in a Friday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
He will remain in his current position until a successor is appointed, and is expected to continue chairing the company's board after he leaves the CEO role.
